coc.title: Code of Conduct
coc.desc: We expect mutual respect and a safe environment. Read our Code of Conduct:

onboarding.title: Onboarding & logistics
items: Check-in with ID; badge visible throughout the event
Join the Telegram group for announcements and support

teams.title: Teams & eligibility
items: Remote teams (2–4 people; solo allowed, but discouraged)
Mentors can guide, but the final work must be the team's
External contributions only with explicit credit and within rules

submissions.title: Submissions
items: Public repo with README (setup, pitch, roadmap)
Functional demo (link, short video, or live demo)
Hard deadline; late submissions will not be judged

ip.title: Intellectual property
items: Code belongs to the team; choose your license (MIT/Apache recommended)
Third‑party use must keep licenses and credits
Share datasets only if you are authorized to do so

mentorship.title: Mentorship & resources
items: Mentors help with guidance, not coding for teams
APIs, SDKs, templates allowed if cited in the README
Avoid dependencies that require private keys outside your control

judging.title: Judging & criteria
items: Innovation and problem relevance
Technical execution and security (basic tests/validations)
Utility/impact and clarity of the pitch
UX and MVP completeness

conduct.title: Conduct & ethics
items: Mutual respect; zero tolerance for harassment and discrimination
No abusive scraping, attacks, or spam to third‑party services
Keep the space clean and follow staff guidance

prizes.title: Prizes & payouts
items: Prizes may be paid by sponsors/foundations (event does not custody funds)
KYC/Wallet requirements may be requested by the payer
Winning teams must be present at the announcement to be eligible

hackathon.starknet_intro: Starknet is a revolutionary ZK-Rollup that provides massive scalability to Ethereum, without sacrificing security. By building on Starknet, you are at the forefront of blockchain innovation. Join our hackathon and build the future of decentralized applications.
hackathon.zk_rollups_desc: ZK-Rollups are Layer 2 scaling solutions that bundle hundreds of transactions into a single one on the main Ethereum chain. This drastically reduces gas fees and increases throughput, making dApps more efficient and affordable.
hackathon.zk_proofs_desc: Zero-Knowledge Proofs allow for the verification of a statement's truth without revealing the statement itself. In blockchain, this means enhanced privacy and security, as transactions can be validated without exposing sensitive data.
hackathon.starknet_description: ZK-Rollup Layer 2 for Ethereum with massive scalability and zero-knowledge proofs
hackathon.cairo_description: Native language for Starknet smart contracts, optimized for STARK proofs
hackathon.cairo_coder_description: AI for Cairo code generation with IDE/CLI support to accelerate development
hackathon.ceo_insights: Direct insights from the CEO of Starknet
